heading: An optional obligation vector
text:
### An optional obligation vector [LTSL.9.1]

Coverage is optional. When enabled, the compiler derives a **vector of obligations**
from rule structure and reports, as definitive findings, the obligations no test
meets. The reachability obligation for a rule is met when some test asserts
`activated <rule>` — keyed on `activated` rather than on any output the rule
produces, since one schema may be emitted by several rules.

This clause states the shape and the reachability obligation: obligations derived
from rule structure, unmet ones reported as findings, the compiler advising while
the author writes every test.
